To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the publications of Context-Award Recommender System follow most of the activities of the ISO 29110 standard for software implementation.
the ISO/IECs 29110 software implementation standard is a suitable standard to guide the development of Context-Aware Recommendation systems.
the publications on CARS do not cover all the activities of 29110, however, they cover the majority of them, and the missing activities are the ones related to the project management.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: What is the current state of the practice in the development of Context-Aware Recommendation System? What are the activities involved in the development of a CARS? What are the main challenges in the development of CARS?
understanding how CARS are developed, and to which extent the ISO/IECs 29110 standard can be applied to CARS.
the following questions: 1) How do CARS publications follow the ISO/IE 29110 standard?, and 2) How to improve the CARS publications to follow the ISO/ IEC 29110 standard?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

Context-Aware Recommenders Systems (CARS), can be built following the Software Engineering process proposed by ISO/IEC29110, and the publications of Context-Aaware Recommender Systems (CAR) are a valuable source of information to build such systems.
CARS publications are not following a structured development approach, however, they are following a development approach that is similar to the ISO/IEEE29110 standard.
CARS publications follow a structured software development process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ISO/IEc 29110 standard can be used for building CARS, however, it needs to be tailored to the CARS domain.
the CARS literature is a valuable source to build a CARS, however it is not structured enough to be used as a reference for a development process.
the ISO/IEc 29110 standard can be used as a guideline to develop Context-Aware Recommenders.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ISO/IEc 29110 Software Engineering Standard is a good candidate for developing Context-Aware Recommenders.
the ISO/IECs 29110 standard can be applied to the building of Context-Aware Recommendation System.
the development of CARS can follow a structured development process that can be used by researchers to build their systems.
